map.EPS = (净利润 − 优先股) / 流通股数: EPS = (net profit − preferred stock) / shares outstanding
map.普通股股东每股享有的盈利。: The earnings attributable to each common share.
map.EPS = (净利−优先股)/流通股数: EPS = (net profit − preferred stock) / shares outstanding
map.净利 1000 万、500 万股 → EPS 2.0。: Net profit 10 million, 5 million shares → EPS 2.0.
map.算每股盈利，做估值分母。: Compute earnings per share, the denominator of valuation.
map.对比不同股本规模公司的盈利能力。: Compare profitability across companies with different share counts.
map.把公司盈利摊薄到每一股，便于不同股本规模的公司横向对比。: Spread company earnings over each share so that firms with different share counts can be compared side by side.
map.净利 1000 万、优先股 0、流通 500 万股: Net profit 10 million, preferred dividend 0, 5 million shares outstanding
map.EPS = (10000000−0)/5000000 = 2 元/股。即每股收益: EPS = (10000000−0)/5000000 = 2 CNY per share. That is, earnings per share of 2 CNY.
map.净利润 3 亿元、优先股股利 0 元、股本 1 亿股: Net profit 300 million CNY, preferred dividend 0 CNY, share capital 100 million shares
map.EPS=(300000000−0)/100000000=3.00 元/股，即每持: EPS=(300000000−0)/100000000=3.00 CNY per share, i.e. each share held corresponds to 3 CNY of annual earnings. If the company has preferred stock, the preferred dividend must be deducted from net profit before dividing by the common share capital.
map.优先股股利优先分走，归母普通股东的利润要扣除优先股部分再除以流通普通股数。: Preferred dividends are paid first, so the profit attributable to common shareholders must exclude the preferred portion before dividing by the number of common shares outstanding.
map.基本 EPS 和稀释 EPS 有什么不同？: What is the difference between basic EPS and diluted EPS?
map.基本 EPS 用期末实际流通股本；稀释 EPS 额外假设可转债、期权、权证全部转: Basic EPS uses the actual shares outstanding at period end; diluted EPS additionally assumes that convertible bonds, options and warrants are all converted into common shares, so the denominator is larger and the value lower. For conservative valuation, look at diluted EPS.
